newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: United Chemical says in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: United Chemical says in acquisition talks.

text.p: Malaysia's United Chemical Industries Bhd (UCI) said on Monday it is completing a major acquisition that would substantially diversify its earnings base.

UCI's newly-appointed chairman Abang Ahmad Urai Abang Mohideen was quoted by the national Bernama news agency as saying the company would issue a statement when the acquisition has been completed within 10 days.
He did not give the name of the company United Chemical was acquiring.
"We cannot release anything now since it would depend on the ongoing talks," he told a news conference to announce the appointment of new board members.
United Chemical shares were suspended from trading on Monday at the company's request. It was last traded at 14.40 ringgit, up 90 cents before the suspension.
The company -- a Second Board stock -- makes and sells polypropylene and polyethylene woven bags and other products,
